post.summary:
ScoreOutput scores a single output synchronously against the given
scorer configs and returns the scores immediately. This is the
interactive counterpart to the background eval-run scorer loop: the
playground uses it to fill in per-cell scores live as outputs stream.
Tenant is resolved from the authenticated context, never from the
request body.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
ScoreOutputRequest scores a single (input, output, expected) triple against
the named scorer configs. Used by the playground to score a grid cell live.

post.summary:
GenerateScorer asks Claude to draft an LLM-judge prompt + rubric for
the user's evaluation intent. Returns a draft scorer config the
caller can edit and save via CreateScoreConfig.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
GenerateScorerRequest asks Claude (via the gateway) to draft an
LLM-judge prompt for the user-described evaluation intent.

Example payload:
  {
    "intent": "score how politely the assistant responded",
    "data_type": "numeric",
    "examples": [
      {"input": "...", "output": "...", "label": "1.0"},
      {"input": "...", "output": "...", "label": "0.0"},
      ...
    ]
  }

retryAll.title: true = reset all items, false = reset only failed

EvalServiceRetryEvalRunBody.description: RetryEvalRunRequest restarts an eval run, optionally retrying all items.

protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

scorerType.title: --- full seed definition so a template prefills the editor (additive) ---

v1ChoiceScore.description: ChoiceScore maps one enumerated judge choice to a 0..1 score.

persist.description:
When true, materialize the comparison into the comparisons table
(both runs must be terminal). When false (default), preview only.

comparison.description: Legacy untyped comparison payload; kept for backward compatibility.

scorerResults.description: Typed per-scorer paired-bootstrap results (candidate vs baseline).

overall.description: Composite verdict across scorers, cost, latency, and error rate.

comparisonId.description: Set when persist=true: id of the materialized comparisons row.

ciLow.description: 95% bootstrap confidence interval on the mean per-item delta.

n.description: Number of paired items backing this scorer's comparison.

v1ComparisonScorerResult.description:
Per-scorer paired-bootstrap comparison result. Deltas are candidate -
baseline; a positive mean_diff means the candidate scored higher.

rationale.description: Human-readable explanation naming the drivers of the grade.

latencyDelta.description: Mean per-item latency delta in ms (candidate - baseline).

coverage.description: Fraction of items that were paired: paired / max(baseline, candidate).

v1ComparisonVerdict.description:
Composite comparison verdict across scorer quality, cost, latency, and
error-rate deltas.

tenantId.title: ignored server-side; tenant from auth context

v1Dataset.title: Dataset represents a collection of test items for evaluation

v1DatasetItem.title: DatasetItem represents a single test case within a dataset

v1DatasetVersion.description: DatasetVersion is an immutable snapshot of a dataset's active items.

v1EvalRun.title: EvalRun represents an evaluation run against a dataset

v1EvalRunItem.title: EvalRunItem represents a single item result within an eval run

label.description:
Free-text label expressing the desired score for this example
(e.g. "1.0", "polite", "false").

intent.description: Free-text description of what to evaluate.

dataType.description: Desired output type: numeric, categorical, boolean. Defaults to numeric.

examples.description: Optional examples to ground the prompt.

v1GenerateScorerRequest.description:
GenerateScorerRequest asks Claude (via the gateway) to draft an
LLM-judge prompt for the user-described evaluation intent.

Example payload:
  {
    "intent": "score how politely the assistant responded",
    "data_type": "numeric",
    "examples": [
      {"input": "...", "output": "...", "label": "1.0"},
      {"input": "...", "output": "...", "label": "0.0"},
      ...
    ]
  }

suggestedName.description: Suggested name for the score config (slug-style, e.g. "politeness").

prompt.description:
The draft LLM-judge prompt template, ready to drop into
ScoreConfig.eval_prompt.

dataType.description: Echoed back so the caller can wire to ScoreConfig.data_type.

suggestedCategories.description: For CATEGORICAL outputs: suggested category values.

notes.description: Anything Claude wanted to flag (ambiguity in examples, etc.).

v1ModelParams.description:
ModelParams mirrors the gateway chat-completions sampling shape so the Go
reader maps 1:1. Only fields the /v1/chat/completions path actually honors
are included (no penalties / verbosity / reasoning_effort — see design doc).

v1Playground.description:
Playground persists a full playground workspace (tasks, dataset, scorers,
grid, view flags) as an opaque JSON config blob so the schema can evolve
without migrations.

filterPredicate.description:
Filter doc using a subset of ListRichTracesRequest fields:
{environment, tags[], user_id, session_id, thread_id, model,
provider, metadata[]}. Empty doc = match all.

sampleRate.description:
Sampling fraction, 0..1. Same trace is consistently in/out across
re-runs via stable hash.

scorerConfigIds.description: Score configs to apply to each sampled trace.

lookbackSeconds.description: How far back the runner looks per tick.

v1SamplingEvalRule.description:
SamplingEvalRule continuously samples production traces matching a
filter and runs scorers against them. Output lands in otel_trace_scores
via the existing score recorder. The polling runner lives in
internal/services/eval_runner/sampling.go.

v1ScoreConfig.title: ScoreConfig defines how to score/grade evaluation outputs

content.title:
Raw text, may contain Mustache vars:
{{input}} {{output}} {{expected_output}} {{context}} {{metadata}}

v1ScoreConfigMessage.description:
ScoreConfigMessage is a single chat-template message for an LLM-judge scorer.
Local copy of prompts/v1.PromptMessage to avoid cross-package wire coupling.

tenantId.description: Ignored server-side; tenant is resolved from the authenticated context.

input.description: The generation input (dataset row / prompt variables). Arbitrary JSON.

output.description: The generated output to score. Arbitrary JSON (string or structured).

expectedOutput.description: Optional expected/reference output for scorers that compare against it.

metadata.description: Optional row metadata passed through to code scorers.

scorerConfigIds.description: Score configs to run (must belong to the caller's tenant).

v1ScoreOutputRequest.description:
ScoreOutputRequest scores a single (input, output, expected) triple against
the named scorer configs. Used by the playground to score a grid cell live.

scores.description:
scores maps score name -> value, plus "<name>_reason" and "<name>_error"
keys, matching the shape written into eval_run_items.scores.
